out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED BAR DISH MACHINE LEAKING DURING USE.
violations.corrective_action: CFM CEASED USE OF MACHINE AND WILL PLACE A CALL FOR REPAIR. BAR DISHES WILL BE WASH, RINSED AND SANITIZED IN HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE IN MAIN KITCHEN.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: OBSERVED HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH THERMOMETER IN NEED OF NEW BATTERY.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PURCHASE REPLACEMENT BATTERY/ADDITIONAL THERMOMETERS TO BE ABLE TO VERIFY TEMPERATURE OF HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED SEVERAL CEILING LIGHT BULBS IN NEED OF REPLACEMENT AND CEILING LIGHTS WITHOUT COVERINGS.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM STATED THEY ARE ACTIVELY WORKING ON REPAIR CEILING LIGHTS AND WILL REPLACE COVERINGS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed cans of residential pesticide at bar and in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. Pesticides removed from kitchen.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Observed accumulation of debris on interior baffle of ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CFM will clean and sanitize baffle of ice machine.

out_items.name: Water and ice from approved source

violations.title: Recent non-public water sample report available
violations.observation: The most recent water sample analysis report for the nonpublic water system is not available on file or from the person in charge.
violations.corrective_action: The most recent sample report for the nonpublic water system shall be retained on file in the food establishment or the report shall be maintained as specified by state water quality regulations. CFM will request from management most recent water test results. EHS recommended CFM to be provided a copies of results whenever available. WESTFIELDS GOLF CLUB RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 07/01/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available or working irreversible registering thermometer to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. CFM will purchase additional batteries and/or heat sensitive test strips and provide proof of purchase to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: ice machine exterior vents.
violations.corrective_action: CFM will clean exterior filter vents of ice machine.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter installed on mop faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided approved backflow prevention device to CFM via email. Provide proof of purchase to EHS within 3 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the wall and caulking behind 3 compartment sink is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: An employee failed to wash his hands before engaging in food preparation after coming into the kitchen from the bar area.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INFORMED CFM AND CFM SPOKE WITH STAFF MEMBER.
